specs.value: Up to 19 colors: up to 4 AMS units (AMS / AMS 2 Pro / AMS HT) and 1 AMS lite connected together
specs.quote: The A2L supports connecting up to 4 AMS units and 1 AMS lite simultaneously (as shown below), enabling printing with up to 19 colors.

specs.value: Below 49 dB (Silent Mode); about 52 dB peak (Standard Mode)

specs.note: An FAQ answer (prose), so unverified; the sheet has no noise row.
